prompt:
Use aged paper, restrained sepia color, halftone print texture, and archival cutout framing.
Treat photographs and documents as tactile evidence layers with legible hierarchy.
Avoid: Glossy modern gradients, neon color, and playful preschool proportions.
Composition: Organize evidence in measured overlapping planes with one dominant archival focal point.
Composition: Preserve readable margins, captions, and document edges instead of filling every gap.
Create one exquisite full-frame cinematic paper-collage environment. Exact landscape 1672x941, no panels or contact sheet. Aged ivory cotton paper, muted indigo photographic printing, restrained amber, sepia halftone, tactile torn edges and shallow paper shadows, realistic elegant proportions. Inside an old empty railway carriage during a quiet coastal journey, cinematic eye-level oblique perspective. Large rounded rectangular window dominates the left and central 65 percent; beyond it a pale blue sea, distant headland, telegraph wires, muted gold morning sky. A worn indigo upholstered bench occupies right middle and lower right, polished brown wood trim, thin warm sunlit curtains at far left. An ivory envelope rests on the small window table. Layered torn photographic paper and fine engraving. Intimate poetic transition from grief to openness. No people, no writing, no signage. Bottom 18 percent softly fades into light ivory paper for lyrics. Gallery quality, richly detailed but spacious. No text, logos or watermarks. Opaque background. The architectural perspective must be coherent.
